data.name: Bidhan
data.gender_notes: Bidhan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bidhan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'vidhana', meaning 'wise' or 'intelligent'. In Hindu mythology, Bidhan is revered as a name of Lord Vishnu, the preserver deity, signifying wisdom and knowledge. This name is believed to bestow upon the child a sharp intellect and a deep understanding of the world. The name Bidhan carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent, Scholar” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bidhan usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent, scholar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
